items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: we were waiting for George Lewis Trio. That's me, him, and George. Yeah. You see, we played plenty of those jobs together, just me and him.

ctx.x: He's sleeping. He gives the drum three chords, and then he plays one solo. Ah. Yeah, yeah, he lazy. He lazy. He's a mute or something, and very weak. Oh, he lazy. If he wasn't that lazy, I bet he could do these beautiful fireworks he used to do.

Oh, man. Yeah, he could play, now he can play, but like I'm telling you, man, what the fuck. He, well, you see, he's got to figure. He's got to figure on how to try to keep on living. If he extend himself to his fullest, he couldn't last long. But I tell you, that's what Papa John's mistake. Yeah. You see, every time you see, he earned his money. The old man, I mean, he'd pray for you. I mean, he'd pray for you. You see, I got a picture of him right now, right there in the store, see where we were, where we…
That's quite an age. Oh, yeah. I mean, for being active. Oh, yeah.
